versions.content: If the Dem module is requested to clear diagnostic information and the selected DTC is set to DTC group `all DTCs' and the selected DTCOrigin is set to DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY or DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_USERDEFINED_MEMORY_<NAME>, the Dem shall reset all event and DTC status bytes and clear event related data assigned to the requested DTCOrigin .

If the Dem module is requested to clear diagnostic information and the selected DTC is set to DTC group `all DTCs' and the selected DTCOrigin is set to DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY or 86 of 501  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R19-11 DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_USERDEFINED_MEMORY_<NAME>, the Dem shall reset all event and DTC status bytes and clear event related data assigned to the requested DTCOrigin .
